notes.title: NEW CHOICES!
notes.content:
After the first week of launch, we continued testing and receiving feedback. So in this new version we focused on adjusting some balances, fixing bugs and also improving performance.

For new content, we added 5 new choices!

Sgt.Boom - Zombie Killer:
Increases your hero damage by 2 for every 250 XP acquired.

Major- Bloodthirst:
Increases your hero damage by 2 for every 25 attacks made.

Scientist - Prize:
Receive 100 money for every 1000 XP acquired.

Captain - Reload practice:
Decreases your hero reload time by 0,01% for every 50 attacks made.

Agent-T - Speeding up:
Increases your hero movement speed by 0,01 for every 500 XP acquired.
